description: This file contains functions for context message pruning, including text/image content processing, message estimation, and pruning logic for agent message transcripts in a chat AI system.

methods.name: asText
methods.description: Converts a string into a TextContent object.

methods.name: collectTextSegments
methods.description: Collects text segments from content blocks, ignoring images.

methods.name: collectPrunableToolResultSegments
methods.description: Collects text segments and image markers from content blocks for pruning.

methods.name: estimateJoinedTextLength
methods.description: Estimates total length of joined text segments with separators.

methods.name: takeHeadFromJoinedText
methods.description: Extracts the first part of joined text up to maxChars.

methods.name: takeTailFromJoinedText
methods.description: Extracts the last part of joined text up to maxChars.

methods.name: hasImageBlocks
methods.description: Checks if content contains image blocks.

methods.name: estimateWeightedTextChars
methods.description: Estimates character count for text with weighting.

methods.name: estimateTextAndImageChars
methods.description: Estimates total character count for content including images.

methods.name: estimateMessageChars
methods.description: Estimates character count for an agent message.

methods.name: estimateContextChars
methods.description: Estimates total character count for a list of messages.

methods.name: findAssistantCutoffIndex
methods.description: Finds index to cutoff assistant messages based on retention count.

methods.name: findFirstUserIndex
methods.description: Finds index of first user message.

methods.name: softTrimToolResultMessage
methods.description: Trims tool result messages based on soft trim settings.

methods.name: pruneContextMessages
methods.description: Main function to prune context messages based on size and settings.
